title: bot.ability.vocal.speech.encoding.chunk
description: One chunk of speech audio encoded by vocal's SpeechEncoding, returned as soon as it is encoded and before the encoding's output (decision D203): a reference to the chunk's audio, its number, and the sound fields its audio says, so playout can start on the first chunk.

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to this chunk's audio, a file of its own: the output reference with .<sequence> before its extension; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

sequence.description: The chunk's number, from 0, in the order the encoding returns its chunks; the chunks in order are the whole utterance, its pauses' silences included [floppy field].
sequence.title: Sequence

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Optional sample rate for raw or decoded audio, measured in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Optional number of audio channels represented by the chunk.
channels.title: Channels

duration.description: Seconds of sound in this chunk, measured from its audio rather than estimated; null when the form does not say [floppy field].
duration.title: Duration
